name: ESP32-P4
scope: Logical GPIO, standard UART/I2C/SPI, LEDC channels, ADC1/ADC2, RMT channels and I2S; single QFN104 (10x10 mm) package (ESP32-P4NRW16/NRW32) that bonds out all 55 GPIOs and keeps flash/PSRAM on dedicated pads, so no GPIO is reserved for memory; LP and high-speed resources not fully checked

source.document: ESP-IDF soc/esp32p4 adc_channel.h (ADC1 GPIO16-23, ADC2 GPIO49-54) + GPIO & RTC GPIO + ESP32-P4 datasheet Table 2-1 Pin Overview (QFN104, all 55 GPIOs bonded)
